name: Joint Meeting of the City Council and the Westlake Village Library Facilities Corporation
agenda_text:
BRAD HALPERN  RAY PEARL  NED E DAVIS  KELLY HONIG  SUSAN McSWEENEY
  Mayor  Mayor Pro Tem  Councilmember  Councilmember  Councilmember

  AGENDA
  Joint Meeting of the City Council and the Westlake Village
  Library Facilities Corporation
  CITY OF WESTLAKE VILLAGE
  City Council Chambers
  31200 Oak Crest Drive

  Wednesday, May 11, 2022 6:30 p.m.

  Written comments may be sent to the City Clerk's Office at carolk@wlv.org no later than
  12:00 p.m. on Wednesday, May 11, 2022. Written comments will be summarized during the
  meeting.

  PUBLIC PARTICIPATION OPTIONS:

  The Public may join this meeting virtually or attend in-person in the Council Chambers.

  Due to the ongoing COVID-19 pandemic, City Council/Board members and staff may be
  participating in this meeting via teleconference pursuant to Government Code Section 54953(e).

  Please click the link below to join the webinar:
  https://us02web.zoom.us/j/83891232108
  Webinar ID: 838 9123 2108
  Or One tap mobile :
  US: +16699009128,,83891232108# or +12532158782,,83891232108
  Or Telephone:
  US: +1 669 900 9128 or +1 253 215 8782 or +1 346 248 7799 or +1 301 715 8592

  Teleconference participants will be muted until recognized at the appropriate time by the Mayor.

  In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related
  modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services,
  please call the City Clerk’s office at (818) 706-1613 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.

  Any disclosable public records related to an open session item on a regular meeting agenda and
  distributed by the City to the City Council less than 72 hours prior to that meeting are available for public
  inspection at City Hall (31200 Oak Crest Drive, Westlake Village) during normal business hours.

  CALL TO ORDER: 6:30 p.m.
 PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE:

ROLL CALL:  City Council and Board members McSweeney, Honig, Davis,
  Mayor Pro Tem Pearl, Mayor Halpern

APPROVAL OF AGENDA:

APPROVAL OF MINUTES:

Minutes of April 27, 2022 City Council Study Session and April 27, 2022 Regular Session.

SPECIAL PRESENTATIONS/CEREMONIAL MATTERS:

  1. Recognition of Carl Koenig for his service with the Westlake Lake Management
  Association.

PUBLIC COMMENTS: Members of the public may address the City Council and Library Facilities
Corporation Board on items not on the printed agenda. Please observe the time limit of three minutes.
Members of the public may offer comment telephonically or otherwise electronically by using Zoom
teleconference service options as listed on Page 1 of this agenda. When attending in-person, complete a
Speaker Card and submit it to the City Clerk prior to the meeting starting.

COUNCIL RESPONSE:

STAFF COMMENTS:

COUNCIL COMMENTS:

JOINT MEETING AGENDA ITEM:

  1. 2022 REFUNDING CERTIFICATES OF PARTICIPATION – Adopt Resolution No.
  2257-22 of the City Council of the City of Westlake Village authorizing the
  Execution, Sale and Delivery of Certificates of Participation in the Aggregate
  Principal Amount Not To Exceed $15,000,000, Authorizing and Directing
  Execution of Related Lease Financing Documents, an Escrow Deposit and Trust
  Agreement, and a Placement Agent Agreement, and Authorizing Official Actions.

  2. Adopt Resolution No. 005-22 of the Board of Directors of the Westlake Village
  Library Facilities Corporation Authorizing the Execution, Sale and Delivery of
  Certificates of Participation in the Aggregate Principal Amount Not To Exceed
  $15,000,000, Authorizing and Directing Execution of Related Lease Financing
  Documents, an Escrow Deposit and Trust Agreement, and Authorizing Official
  Actions.

RECESS Library Facilities Corporation to continue City Council Meeting.

CITY COUNCIL COMMITTEE REPORTS:
 PUBLIC HEARINGS:

1.  PUBLIC HEARING FOR CONDITIONAL USE PERMIT NO. 14-011
  MODIFICATION 2; RESOLUTION NO. 2259-22 – Adopt a Resolution approving
  Modification 2 to Conditional Use Permit No. 14-011 to authorize the sale of
  alcoholic beverages in conjunction with a restaurant and the operation of a cocktail
  lounge and private event space at 30760 Russell Ranch Road, Suites C and D.

2.  INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE AMENDING CHAPTER 9.21 OF THE
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE PERTAINING TO OAK TREE AND
  HERITAGE TREE PRESERVATION STANDARDS; ORDINANCE NO. 292-22–
  Introduce an Ordinance Regarding Oak Tree and Heritage Tree Preservation
  Standards Chapter 9.21 and Amending the Westlake Village Municipal Code.

CONSENT CALENDAR: Matters listed under the Consent Calendar are considered to be routine and
will be enacted by one motion and one vote. Unless otherwise requested by a Councilmember, there will
be no separate discussion of these items. If discussion is desired, that item will be removed from the
Consent Calendar and will be considered separately.

  APPROVAL OF WARRANTS: Warrants effective May 15, 2022 the amount of
  $645,681.60.

  GENERAL BUSINESS:

  1. ASSEMBLY BILL 361 FINDINGS FOR SPECIAL BROWN ACT
  REQUIREMENTS FOR TELECONFERENCE MEETINGS – Consideration to
  make the following findings so that teleconference meetings of the City Council
  and the City’s committees can continue to be conducted pursuant to the AB
  361 special Brown Act requirements: (1) the City Council has reconsidered the
  circumstances of the COVID-19 state of emergency; and (2) state and local
  officials continue to recommend measures to promote social distancing.”

  2. CONSIDERATION OF BRIGHTVIEW CONTRACT AMENDMENT NO. 5 FOR
  PARK PERIMETER LANDSCAPE AND IRRIGATION MAINTENANCE –
  Consideration to 1) approve a contract amendment with BrightView extending
  the term of the agreement on a month-to-month basis at the current
  compensation of $23,210 per month; and 2) authorize the Mayor and City Clerk
  to execute the contract amendment on behalf of the City.

  3. CONSIDERATION OF AMENDMENT NO. 3 FOR THE LANDSCAPE AND
  IRRIGATION MAINTENANCE AGREEMENT WITH AMERICAN HERITAGE
  LANDSCAPE – Consideration to 1) approve a contract amendment with
  American Heritage extending the term of the agreement on a month-to-month
  basis at the current compensation of $36,181 per month; and 2) authorize the
  Mayor and City Clerk to execute the contract amendment on behalf of the City.
   4. ACCEPTANCE OF THE TRAFFIC SIGNAL POLE PAINTING PROJECT,
  PHASE 1 – Consideration to (1) Appropriate $36,784 from Lighting
  Assessment District No. 1 for the Traffic Signal Pole Painting, Phase 1 Project;
  (2) accept the 2021 Traffic Signal Pole Painting, Phase 1 Project; and (3)
  authorize the City Clerk to execute and record a “Notice of Completion” on
  behalf of the City.

OLD BUSINESS:

NEW BUSINESS:

  1. INTRODUCTION OF ORDINANCE AMENDING ARTICLE 10 OF THE
  WESTLAKE VILLAGE MUNICIPAL CODE REGARDING SUBDIVISION
  REGULATIONS; ORDINANCE NO. 293-22 – Introduce Ordinance No. 293-
  22, titled ‘An Ordinance of the City of Westlake Village adopting by reference
  Title 21 and Chapter 22.170 of Title 22 of the Los Angeles County Code,
  together with certain amendments, additions, and fees, and amending the
  Westlake Village Municipal Code.’

ADJOURNMENT:

This agenda was posted on Thursday, May 5 at 4:30 p.m. on the City’s website and in
the Posting Board at City Hall. To access Agendas and Staff Reports, go to www.wlv.org
and click on “City Council Agendas, Minutes & Video.” City Council meetings can be seen
live on WVTV Channel 10 or via web streaming on www.wlv.org.
